Rank 04 - Retail

Pharmacy Stock and Expiry Control

Pharmacies lose money through expired products, batch confusion, supplier dues, and fast-moving stockouts.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 10,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 500Recommended monthly charge

BDT 500/month is safer than BDT 200 because pharmacy catalog complexity creates more support. Charge for barcode/printer as pro setup.

8.5Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 10,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 500Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 16,000,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Licensed pharmacy reporting is above 220,000. A 1,000-customer target is below 0.5 percent of that licensed base.

Owner forgets expiry dates, staff sells without checking batch, supplier due is scattered, and near-expiry stock becomes dead loss.

One expired box can cost more than the monthly fee. The system warns before loss happens.

Validation signals

  • Pharmacy count is large.
  • Expiry loss is concrete and easy to understand.
  • Batch and supplier dues are daily workflow problems.
  • Owners can pay more than ordinary grocery shops.

MVP modules

  • Medicine item list
  • Batch and expiry date
  • Purchase and supplier due
  • Sale and sales return
  • Near-expiry report
  • Low-stock report
  • Daily close

Do not build first

  • Do not provide medical advice.
  • Do not build prescription telemedicine.
  • Do not promise regulatory compliance without expert review.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Start with 20 pharmacies in one town.
  • Enter top 300 products first, not full catalog.
  • Prove near-expiry report value.
  • Add barcode after the core stock workflow works.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Product catalog can become heavy.
  • Wrong expiry entry reduces trust.
  • Some pharmacy owners avoid formal records.
Mitigations
  • Start with high-moving items.
  • Use quick duplicate product entry.
  • Keep reports owner-private.
